issues.title: GAME — Super Mario Kart
issues.body: as close to original as you can get but by building your own assets.

issues.title: QA — Forge: auto-recover from hung sessions (oMLX restart / dead requests)
issues.body: **where:** https://jalfern.com/retrogames/forge

issues.title: QA — The forge itself
issues.body: **where:** https://jalfern.com/retrogames/

issues.title: GAME — The Legend of Zelda
issues.body: Build out NES Legend of Zelda as close to the original as possible. To make it tractable, start with either a 2x2 or 3x3 set of screens from this

issues.title: GAME — Spy Hunter!
issues.body: Go all out. Make it a faithful replica of the original 80s game. Both graphics and gameplay should mimic the original. To keep it contained you only need to build first 2 levels.

issues.title: FORGE PULSE
issues.body: Machine-updated status line for https://jalfern.com/retrogames/forge — do not close.

issues.title: GAME 12 — Papers-Please-Min
issues.body: Document rules gameplay, generated immigrants. New muscle: rule engine + a prover that no generated paper is unfair.

issues.title: GAME 06 — Ice Climber Co-op
issues.body: Two climbers, dug-through terrain, local 2P. New muscle: mutable tilemap + second simultaneous input path.

issues.title: GAME 05 — Momentum Runner (Sonic-like)
issues.body: Slopes, loops, speed-shifting platforming. New muscle: angle-based collision; levelcheck gets a velocity-reachability audit.

issues.title: GAME — Excite bike
issues.body: Muscle to stretch is fedility to the original excite bike nes game as possible. graphics, level design, controls -- make it feel close and faithful to the original. take your time, don't worry how long it takes. the closer to a true recreation the better you have achieved the goal.

issues.title: Wizardry! —
issues.body: Build the classic dungeon crawler of early days - wizardry!

issues.title: Paperboy! (style of nes)
issues.body: build out the original paper boy using style similar to nes (higher end / better than our typical retro games motif). game play and levels should be like the original.

issues.title: GAME 16 — Forge Conveyor (factory floor visualization)
issues.body: Stretch goal, dogfooding: turn /forge's lamp panel into an animated **factory floor** rendered from the data the board already fetches (pulse tokens + label lists — no new API calls).

issues.title: GAME — beezee. a first person honeybee flier
issues.body: Think Magic Carpet meets Bug's Life. You are a honey bee from a hive that has the goal of finding nectar and bringing back the nectar and pollen to the hive before the sun sets. You have spider webs, wasps, birds, and a pet gecko to contend with. You have an ultraviolet vision mode to zero into the

issues.title: GAME 15 — WWI Dogfight 3D
issues.body: Altitude, stall, ammo belts on a fixed-wing sim. New muscle: flight model + instruments, extends the three.js stack.

issues.title: GAME 13 — Lode Runner
issues.body: Destructible floors, enemy pathfinding, ghost replay of your own runs. New muscle: determinism + recorded-input harness.

issues.title: GAME 11 — Outpost Roguelike (Dwarf-style)
issues.body: Jobs, hunger, pathing, procedural depths, ASCII. New muscle: job queue + A* on Rogue's bones.

issues.title: GAME 10 — SimCity-Min
issues.body: Grid city, economy ticks, disaster mode. New muscle: long-horizon sim + stat harness proving the economy is stable/fun.

issues.title: GAME 09 — Missile Battle Sim
issues.body: Saturation attacks, intercept math, limited interceptors. New muscle: vector-field simulation + deterministic attack waves.

issues.title: GAME 08 — Polarity Shooter (Ikaruga-like)
issues.body: Light/dark switching: same-color absorbs, opposite kills. New muscle: rule-driven enemy AI + a fairness auditor.

issues.title: GAME 07 — Galaga
issues.body: Formation dives, tractor beam, player-capture rescue bonus. New muscle: scripted enemy behavior trees with verifiable dive paths.

issues.title: GAME 04 — Metroid-lite
issues.body: Scrolling map with ability-gated backtracking, save beacons. New muscle: world-state flow machine + parallax.

issues.title: GAME 03 — Sonar Roguelike
issues.body: You only see what sound reveals — ping, listen, map the room in your head. New muscle: deferred-reveal renderer; harness asserts the info the player actually received.

issues.title: GAME 02 — Boulder Dash
issues.body: Dirt digging, falling boulders and gems, chain-explosion timer. New muscle: cellular automata + heistcheck-style headless reachability/explosion audit.

issues.title: GAME 01 — Lemmings-lite
issues.body: One-click skill assignment (walker→blocker/climber/digger/bomber), per-lemming agents, deterministic replay. New muscle: agent-per-entity sim; the gate is a Node solver proving each level is solvable before it ships.
